[NSBK.1.1] The compiler chooses a backing algorithm per series at compile time
and records it in the `.dsc` as the series' **atom**, one of the seven of
[NSBK.6.1] (`SeriesBackendRingBuffer` for a ring buffer,
`SeriesBackendWelfordEwma` for Welford running stats). At `ds_engine_load_dsc`,
the engine must have a backend **registered for every backing the artefact
uses**; a missing one fails the load with `DS_ERR_BACKEND_NOT_REGISTERED`. An engine
registers all seven ([NSBK.2.3]), so an artefact that names one of them does not
meet this refusal.
